nodes.label: Havlíček et al. 2019
nodes.author: Havlíček, V., Córcoles, A. D., Temme, K., Harrow, A. W., Kandala, A., Chow, J. M., & Gambetta, J. M.
nodes.rationale: Established foundational supervised-learning approach using quantum-enhanced feature spaces and a variational quantum classifier. Introduced ZZFeatureMap.

nodes.label: Cerezo et al. 2021
nodes.author: Cerezo, M., Arrasmith, A., Babbush, R., et al.
nodes.rationale: Identifies trainability (barren plateaus), accuracy, and efficiency as core challenges for variational quantum algorithms (VQAs).

nodes.label: Gupta et al. 2025
nodes.author: Gupta, R. S., Wood, C. E., Engstrom, T., Pole, J. D., & Shrapnel, S.
nodes.rationale: Systematic review of QML for digital health found no consistent empirical trend supporting quantum utility over classical methods.

nodes.label: WDBC Dataset
nodes.author: Wolberg, W., Mangasarian, O., Street, N., & Street, W.
nodes.rationale: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic) dataset; 569 instances, 30 features, binary target.

nodes.label: Mpofu & Mthunzi-Kufa 2025
nodes.author: Mpofu, K., & Mthunzi-Kufa, P.
nodes.rationale: Compares ANNs vs VQCs for biomedical data classification using WDBC.

nodes.label: Kundu, Muhuri & Kumar 2025
nodes.author: Kundu, A., Muhuri, S., & Kumar, R.
nodes.rationale: Studies quantum-classical hybrid techniques for breast cancer prediction using WDBC.

nodes.label: Prajapati et al. 2025
nodes.author: Prajapati, J. B., et al.
nodes.rationale: Listed as 2025 but likely a 2023 Springer book chapter. Discusses QML in breast cancer prediction.

nodes.label: Pushpanjali & Adisesha 2025
nodes.author: Pushpanjali, P., & Adisesha, K.
nodes.rationale: Benchmarking QML models against classical techniques for breast cancer diagnosis.

nodes.label: ZZFeatureMap
nodes.rationale: Quantum encoding circuit introduced by Havlíček et al. 2019.

nodes.label: Variational Quantum Classifier (VQC)
nodes.rationale: A supervised learning approach using parameterized quantum circuits.
